name: Chromatic Dragon, Orange
body:
NE dragon (air, earth)

BASE STATISTICS

Subpages

CR 3; Size Tiny; Hit Dice 4d12
Speed 60 ft., climb 60 ft.
Natural Armor +3; Breath Weapon line, 2d4 piercing and slashing (thorns) plus poison
Str 10, Dex 17, Con 13, Int 9, Wis 11, Cha 9

ECOLOGY

Environment tropical forests (jungle canopies)
Organization solitary
Treasure triple

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Agonizing Venom (Ex)

Any creature failing its saving throw against a young or older orange dragon’s breath weapon, poison, or poisonous aura is sickened with pain for 1 minute. A second, third, and fourth failed saving throw mean the creature is also staggered for 1 minute, nauseated for 1 minute, and helpless for 1 minute, respectively. This is a pain effect.

Improved Woodland Stride (Su)

An old or older orange dragon can move through any sort of undergrowth at its normal speed without taking damage or suffering other impairment. This includes thorns, briars, and overgrown areas that are magically manipulated to impede motion.

Poison (Ex)

Aura, bite or breath weapon—inhaled, injury, or contact, save Fortitude, frequency 1/round for 5 rounds, effect 1d4 Con, cure 1 save. An adult or older dragon’s poison requires 2 consecutive saves, and ancient and older dragon’s poison requires 3 consecutive saves. The save DC is equal to the orange dragon’s breath weapon DC.

Poisonous Aura (Su)

An adult or older orange dragon exudes a toxic aroma. All creatures within 5 feet are subject to an inhalable version of the orange dragon’s poison. An old orange dragon’s aura extends out 10 feet. Any creature starting their turn within the aura is subject to this poison, as well as any creature entering this aura.

Spell-Like Abilities (Sp)

An orange dragon gains the following spell-like abilities, usable at will upon reaching the listed age category. Young—vanish; Juvenile—obscure poison; Adult—pernicious poison; Old—toxic blood; Ancient—cloudkill; Great wyrm—poison.

Woodland Stride (Ex)

A very young or older orange dragon can move through any sort of foliage at full speed without taking damage or suffering impairment. Areas of foliage that have been magically manipulated affect it normally.

Wyrmling	Immune to poison, poison	—
